summary: Frontend retest of the crypto-auto activation flow after E1's fix to ALLOWED_FOR_PENDING whitelist. ALL 5 previously-blocked scenarios now PASS end-to-end: (1) Fresh pending user (registered via API with sponsor=admin, accept_terms=true) sees the 4th tile 'mode-crypto-auto' on /activation when crypto_auto flag is ON. (2) Clicking the tile navigates to /(app)/activation-crypto-auto and the page renders correctly — email, @username, '5 USDT 🔒', 'USDT BEP20 🔒', and 'Payer maintenant' button all visible. NO bounce back to /activation. (3) Clicking 'cauto-pay' triggers the real biz-transPay gateway; after ~15s cauto-address, cauto-copy button, QR code, reference 'SPLV_CRYPTO_...', BEP20 network label and the 'En attente de la confirmation du paiement (webhook)…' spinner are all rendered. (4) When crypto_auto is toggled OFF via admin API and the URL is visited directly, the FeatureGuard placeholder (data-testid='feature-disabled-crypto_auto') renders with the padlock icon and 'Activation automatique (Crypto) désactivée' message — NOT redirected to /activation. (5) With flag OFF, the mode-crypto-auto tile is absent from /activation. Cleanup: crypto_auto flag left = false per default policy. The iter_28 blocker is fully resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: The fix is minimal and correct: 'activation-crypto-auto' added to ALLOWED_FOR_PENDING set in /app/frontend/app/(app)/_layout.tsx line 13. No regressions observed on the other allowed routes.

Suggestion (non-blocking): the ALLOWED_FOR_PENDING pattern is fragile — every new pending-user-only screen needs a manual whitelist edit and there is no compile-time safeguard. Consider colocating the 'pending-allowed' flag with each route (e.g. an export const `allowedForPending = true` picked up at build time) so this class of bug cannot recur.

E1's one-line fix (adding the string to the Set in _layout.tsx line 13) resolves it.
